description.value:
Break Effect score +3. Your Breaks and those of the configured Break partner deal +2 damage. Implanting a weakness restores 1 SP, once per Ultimate cycle. Default partner: conscious ally with highest Break Effect.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching nihility Path required.
